name: engine
description: annnä is four layers — **Model / Harness / Engine / App** (the full map: [`../README.md`](../README.md)) — and this folder is the Engine: **the only layer where truth lives**. It is the persistent store (commitments, boards, rules, grants, latches, shared artifacts, orders) plus the deterministic math on it (availability, gaps, travel, quotas, placement). It is **built**, not imported; its only client is the **Harness**, which calls it through a seam pinned before this design existed (`../harness/INTERFACES.md §1`). The engine never talks to the model, a user, or a third party.
